strongest_angle: Examines the October 2026 collapse and rapid pre-pack administration of UK telecom provider TalkTalk, focusing on the lender complaints submitted to ministers and the Competition and Markets Authority.

key_facts.fact: BT Group acquired TalkTalk Telecommunications Limited and PlatformX Communications Limited out of administration on October 5, 2026, to protect service continuity for 2.5 million customers.
BT Group agreed to pay £400 million ($530 million) for TalkTalk's consumer and wholesale units in an immediate pre-pack administration sale on October 5, 2026.
The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) launched a merger inquiry and served an order under the Enterprise Act 2002 regarding BT's completed acquisition of TalkTalk.
TalkTalk entered administration and was sold to BT the same morning in a pre-pack administration that drew complaints from its largest lender to ministers and the CMA.
